evidence: Static review: every interactive, time-varying or viewport-dependent promise has a criterion that tells the judge to act, not to read a first paint. Viewport: ui.md:17 (390 px usable) is graded by tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:68 cw_narrow_width_usable: 'Resize the browser viewport to about 390 by 844 pixels and reload ... type a one-line program in the editor, Run it ... Restore the desktop viewport afterwards'; Playwright MCP is wired (polish/judge.toml:8-12) and offers a resize tool. Animation: the golden caret blinks (style.css:18 'animation:cw-caret 1s step-end infinite') and visual/prompt.md:12 says 'click into the code, select one word with a double click, and watch the caret for about two seconds, because a caret may blink', plus 'put a ten-line JavaScript draft in the editor and Run it once' and a stated 1440 by 900 viewport (visual/prompt.md:11), so the visual Likert rows are not scored on an empty first paint. Waits: functional/prompt.md:25 'Where waiting is required, wait the stated time; do not shorten it', and timed criteria state the wait and a positive control: functional/judge.toml:263 (wait at least eight more seconds, then click), :281 (within about ten seconds), :290 and :299 (wait at least eight more seconds, void-attempt rule), :362 and :380 (watch up to ten seconds without acting in A). Interaction: prompts require real key presses, clicks, drags and modifier-clicks (functional/prompt.md:20; polish/prompt.md:17); focus visibility is graded by tabbing (polish/judge.toml:23); auto-scroll by keyboard movement (functional/judge.toml:83); disabled-state toggling of Undo/Redo across three points (polish/judge.toml:50); unsaved marker across four states (polish/judge.toml:59). Theming: no theme switch is required by the brief (ui.md has none) and no criterion grades one, so there is nothing to toggle. Weak-app probe: a static shell fails the render gate and each prompt's global gate; a non-responsive desktop-only layout fails cw_narrow_width_usable because typing and Run must be done at 390 px; a caret visible only in one blink phase is still observed thanks to the two-second watch. Conforming-alternative probe: a canvas editor or non-blinking caret is not penalised (app_context.md:25; 'may blink'). Minor observation (P3, not a defect of this row): visual/judge.toml:40 asks for 'consistency of buttons, fields and notices' while visual/prompt.md:12 only triggers one successful Run, so error/conflict notices may not be on screen; the Run status and console entry still provide a notice-type surface. Runtime: scripted golden evidence only (polish.json all 7 true; polish.cjs:101,120 set 390x844 and 1440x900); artifact hashes verified. No configured LLM judge run exists, so whether the judge actually resizes, waits and toggles as instructed is unmeasured; risk stays true for that reason.
suggested_fix: Optional: in visual/prompt.md add one step that triggers a failing Run (thrown error) before the screenshots so a notice is visible for cw_visual_component_finish, or drop 'notices' from that criterion. Obtain a configured judge run to confirm the resize and wait steps are actually performed.
